title: Oven Roasted Kenyan Meat Kebabs
description: A charred, flaky, and light Kenyan dish featuring ground cinnamon and dashi extract, cooked to perfection on a salt block. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, ground cinnamon, dashi extract, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Thread the meat mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the salt block with olive oil and place it in the oven for 10 minutes to preheat.
Remove the salt block from the oven and place the skewers on it.
Return the salt block to the oven and roast the kebabs for 15 minutes, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
